content_html:
watched #Acharya : DISASTER!!!! when was the last time Chiru’s movie has left ZERO Impact (irrespective of Hit or Flop) for me it was Shankar Dada Zindabad and now Acharya took that spot!!!!

There was No Impact of the Story, as Akhanda has similar and more powerful story line!!!

There was no impact of the Violent Climax, as again Akhanda had more violence!!!

There was no impact of the elevation shots, as we all are in KGF elevation hangover!!!

There was no awe factor of the multi-starer , as RRR had a more awe feeling due to Ram and NTR combination!!!

There was no impact of the Father-Son combination, as Manam had a womderful Father-Son combination impact!!!

So to say there is nothing new to offer in this movie…nor what offered is impactful 🙏

Its end of Manisharma….Lahe Lahe had more impact due to its lyrics and other 3 songs reminded me of the late 90’s or early 20’s era 🙏….The movie would have had more impact without BGM 🤦‍♂️

And RamCharan’s Sidha’s role was added considering the commercial viability rather than any other importance….

Hope the BOSS will be back soon….
